source_work: Noah Webster, An American Dictionary of the English Language (1828)
rights_basis: The original 1828 dictionary text is public domain.
transcription_source: WebstersDictionary1828.com entry transcriptions checked against the Internet Archive full-resolution page scans.
selection_method: Restored five useful English headwords missed by the base OCR import, then mapped only transparent KJV inflections, archaic forms, and British spellings to approved dictionary headwords.
review_method: Compared every promoted entry with the printed 1828 page scan, corrected only clear transcription or Scripture-reference errors, and confirmed every lookup target exists in approved dictionary data. Names and unclear compounds were left unresolved.
